claim: Including actual bulk-only patients reveals an HSPC severity association and strengthens FDR support for ASC severity and HSPC mortality associations.

metric.name: Patient-level clinical association
metric.unit: raw leukocyte percent, Spearman rho, or death AUC as labeled
metric.aggregation: Equal-visit patient means; within-source rank INT for association tests
metric.denominator: 37 Real patients plus 29 genuinely additional patients; BH43 per endpoint

data_source.notes: All plotting inputs are package-relative copies of canonical25; no statistical refitting or new selection.

uncertainty.note: Fixed-score percentile patient bootstrap; rho stratified by source, AUC by source x outcome. No generator, annotation or selection uncertainty. Raw patient points shown in B.

annotations.text: HSPC severity: Real P=.574; Combined q43=.0168; source-permutation q43=.0182
HSPC death and IgG/IgA severity FDR rescue

exceptions.reason: Five approved panels form one patient-expansion and rare-cell association argument; all text remains at least8pt at178mm.
